=Module <<a_api_type subproject="client" | module Group >> =
<<pre class="ocsforge_color odocwiki_code"|<<span class="ocsforge_color_keyword"|module>> <<span class="ocsforge_color_uid"|<<span class="ocsforge_color_uid"|Group>>>> <<span class="ocsforge_color_delimiter"|~:>> <<span class="ocsforge_color_keyword"|sig>><<a_api subproject="client" text=".." | module Group >><<span class="ocsforge_color_keyword"|end>>>>~Groups of users~.
    ~Groups are sets of users~. ~Groups and group members are saved in database~.
    ~Groups are used by ~O~S for example to restrict access to pages or
    server functions~.

----

~Exception raised when no there is no group corresponding to the request ~(for
    example wrong ~I~D or name~)~.

~Type alias to <<a_api subproject="client" | type Types.Group.id >> to allow to use <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|~Group~.id>>~.

~Type alias to <<a_api subproject="client" | type Types.Group.t >> to allow to use <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|~Group~.t>>~.

<<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|id~_of~_group group>> returns the group ~I~D~.

<<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|name~_of~_group group>> returns the group name~.

<<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|desc~_of~_group group>> returns the group description~.

<<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|create ~~description name>> creates a new group in the database and returns
    it as a record of type <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|~Types~.~Group~.t>>~.

~Overwrites the function <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|group~_of~_name>> of <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|~Db~.~Group>> and use
    the <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|get>> function of the cache module~.

<<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|add~_user~_in~_group ~~group ~~userid>> adds the user with ~I~D <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|userid>> to
    <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|group>>~.

<<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|remove~_user~_in~_group ~~group ~~userid>> removes the user with ~I~D <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|userid>> from
    <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|group>>~.

<<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|in~_group ~~group ~~userid>> returns <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|true>> if the user with ~I~D <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|userid>> is in
    <<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|group>>~.

<<span class="odocwiki_inlinecode"|all ~(~)>> returns all the groups of the database~.
